The '''Bone Rug''' is a piece of [[furniture]] available from the [[Furniture Catalogue]] for {{Price|0}}.

One Bone Rug is obtained when the [[Farmhouse|Bedroom]] is redecorated by [[Penny]] in her [[Penny#Fourteen Hearts|14-Heart]] event, choosing Pirate Theme.
